newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal government may fine tune budget-Guterres.
newsitem.headline: Portugal government may fine tune budget-Guterres.

text.p: The Portuguese government will consider fine-tuning the 1997 budget proposals as long as suggestions do not affect key policy areas, raise the deficit or alter revenue targets, Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said.

"Our willingness to hold a dialogue with those who wish to fine-tune the budget is not prejudiced, as long as the deficit does not increase and the structure of revenues is not altered," he told a parliamentary debate on the budget.
He also said the Socialist government would not reconsider its investment spending priorities, its social policies and its pledge to guarantee citizens' security.
Parliament voted to approve the general terms of the budget on Friday ahead of a final vote on December 11.
